name: Notional Quantity Legs 5
definition: Indicates the notional quantity of the underlying assets.

FirstLeg.name: First Leg
FirstLeg.definition: Aggregate notional quantity of the underlying asset of leg 1 for the term of the transaction. Where the total notional quantity is not known when a new transaction is reported, the total notional quantity is updated as it becomes available.

SecondLeg.name: Second Leg
SecondLeg.definition: Aggregate notional quantity of the underlying asset of leg 2 for the term of the transaction. Where the total notional quantity is not known when a new transaction is reported, the total notional quantity is updated as it becomes available.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
